chunks.rationale: Read first: this is why Merge kept dying. When the sole unmerged path is .solenta/review-itinerary.json, combine ours+theirs (dedupe by area/risk) and stage it. Wired at mergeWorktree start, squash-into-main, replay-into-worktree, and updatePrBranchFromBase.
risks: A real conflict that happens to include other files still surfaces as MERGE_CONFLICT — only the itinerary-only case is swallowed.
Malformed JSON on both sides falls back to --ours; if that also fails we still throw.
The running Solenta process loads worktrees.js from its own checkout; this fix is live only after this lands on main and the app reloads.
